blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Thousands of protesters took to the streets of Manila on Tuesday to denounce US President Donald Trump’s visit for the United States-Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Summit, condemning Washington’s military presence in the Philippines and a US-backed initiative they fear could displace indigenous communities and farmers.
